readings: Compute each equipment’s average from its non-null scanenvironment.humepct readings. Use the arithmetic mean of those equipment averages as the all-equipment reference average, excluding equipment with no non-null readings. Select equipment whose average exceeds that reference, and use the arithmetic mean of the selected equipment averages as the group reference average. Return the 10 selected equipment with the largest signed difference between their average and the group reference average. Show equipref, its average humidity, its difference from the all-equipment reference average, and its difference from the group reference average. Return no rows if either reference average is missing. Sort by the group-reference difference descending, with missing values last and equipref ascending to break ties.

Compute each equipment’s average from its non-null scanenvironment.humepct readings. Use the average of all non-null scanenvironment.humepct readings, regardless of equipment, as the all-equipment reference average. Select equipment whose average exceeds that reference, and use the arithmetic mean of the selected equipment averages as the group reference average. Return the 10 selected equipment with the largest signed difference between their average and the group reference average. Show equipref, its average humidity, its difference from the all-equipment reference average, and its difference from the group reference average. Return no rows if either reference average is missing. Sort by the group-reference difference descending, with missing values last and equipref ascending to break ties.
queries:
WITH equipment_averages AS (
    SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
    FROM scanenvironment
    GROUP BY equipref
    HAVING COUNT(humepct) > 0
),
all_reference AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS reference_avg
    FROM equipment_averages
),
selected AS (
    SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_humidity,
           e.avg_humidity - a.reference_avg AS all_reference_difference
    FROM equipment_averages AS e
    CROSS JOIN all_reference AS a
    WHERE e.avg_humidity > a.reference_avg
),
group_reference AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS reference_avg
    FROM selected
)
SELECT s.equipref,
       s.avg_humidity,
       s.all_reference_difference,
       s.avg_humidity - g.reference_avg AS group_reference_difference
FROM selected AS s
CROSS JOIN all_reference AS a
CROSS JOIN group_reference AS g
WHERE a.reference_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND g.reference_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY group_reference_difference IS NULL,
         group_reference_difference DESC,
         s.equipref ASC
LIMIT 10

WITH equipment_avg AS (
    SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
    FROM scanenvironment
    WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY equipref
),
all_reference AS (
    SELECT AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
    FROM scanenvironment
),
selected AS (
    SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_humidity
    FROM equipment_avg AS e
    CROSS JOIN all_reference AS a
    WHERE e.avg_humidity > a.avg_humidity
),
group_reference AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS avg_humidity
    FROM selected
)
SELECT
    s.equipref,
    s.avg_humidity,
    s.avg_humidity - a.avg_humidity AS all_reference_difference,
    s.avg_humidity - g.avg_humidity AS group_reference_difference
FROM selected AS s
CROSS JOIN all_reference AS a
CROSS JOIN group_reference AS g
WHERE a.avg_humidity IS NOT NULL
  AND g.avg_humidity IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    group_reference_difference IS NULL,
    group_reference_difference DESC,
    s.equipref ASC
LIMIT 10
